queries: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, o.overall_avg FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins, a.avg_wins - a.overall_avg AS above_overall_average, a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_group_average FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC, a.country
